title: Product Code Data Segment
applicability: Conditionally included in Data Section 3 for fuel/product transactions; not used for Comdata cards.
scopeNote: Core-structure baseline: Segment Type/Length and cross-segment business rules only. Not field-by-field exhaustive.

businessRequirements.title: Segment Type field in the Product Code Data Segment has fixed value 102.
Segment Length identifies the Product Code Data Segment's total length including Segment Type and Field Separators.
Fuel products (and the primary fuel product for multi-fuel transactions) must always be the first products in the segment.
A maximum of ten products is allowed in the Product Code Data Segment.
The total of product amounts in Segment 102 must equal the sum of Fuel Purchase Amount, Nonfuel Amount, Tax Amount, and Cash Amount in Segment 100.
Segment 102 (Product Code Data Segment) and Segment 157 (Adjusted Product Code Data) are mutually exclusive; sending both causes a decline.

testCases.positive: Product amount total equals Segment 100 amount fields
Only one of Segment 102 or 157 present

testDataStatus: Segment Type and amount-reconciliation rules are covered by existing Segment 100 amount packages; fuel-ordering, product-limit, and 102/157 mutual exclusion need dedicated artifacts.
remaining: Author full field-by-field Product Code Data Segment coverage (Service Level, Unit of Measure, Quantity, Unit Price) beyond this core-structure baseline.
